title: Add Reckless engine to catalog with Featured badge

source.notes: Reckless is a Rust chess engine ranked #2 globally (SPCC 3833). AGPL-3.0 licensed. v0.9.0 binaries for all platforms.

description: Add Reckless v0.9.0 to the engine download catalog with a Featured badge. 6 catalog entries (3 OS x 2 CPU tiers). Binaries hosted on enparlant.redshed.ai CDN. Featured badge renders as orange-yellow gradient on EngineCard. Image field set to null pending logo upload to CDN.
notes: Reckless binaries are raw executables (not archives) — download_file handles this correctly
macOS has one universal binary used for both bmi2=true and bmi2=false entries
AVX-512 variants skipped — AVX2 and generic cover all users
Logo from GitHub README (user-attachments URL) not publicly downloadable — needs manual browser save and CDN upload

done_criteria: Reckless appears in engine Download tab with Featured badge
